subject: english
question:
**Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.**

Kavya said to her husband, “I don’t mind being a busy woman.”

options.text: Kavya told her husband that she had not mind being a busy woman.
Kavya told her husband that she do not mind being a busy woman.
Kavya said to her husband she did not mind being a busy woman.
Kavya told her husband that she did not mind being a busy woman.

solution:
The correct answer is **Kavya told her husband that she did not mind being a busy woman**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reported speech is given in **Present indefinite tense.** 
 
• If reported verb is in **Past Tense**, reported speech will change from **Present Indefinite Tense to Past Indefinite Tense.**
 
• **Said to **will be changed to **told **and **do not** will be changed to **did not**.
 
• **'I'** in reported speech will be changed to '**she' (according to the speaker).**
 
• Thus, the correct indirect form of the given sentence is** option 4**.

**Correct Sentence:**__ *Kavya told her husband that she did not mind being a busy woman.*
